summary: Territory of Guam. Unincorporated organized territory of the us with local self-government; republican form of territorial government with separate executive, legislative, and judicial branches.
rulers: President Donald J. TRUMP (since 20 January 2025); Governor Lourdes LEON GUERRERO (since 7 January 2019)
government: unincorporated organized territory of the US with local self-government; republican form of territorial government with separate executive, legislative, and judicial branches
economy: small Pacific island US territorial economy; upper income, tourism-based economy; hard-hit by COVID-19 disruptions; relaunched many industries via vaccination tourism; domestic economy relies on multiple military bases; environmentally fragile economy
military: Guam Police Department (GPD); Guam (US) National Guard
